name: 1B1T Bedrock Anarchy
description: 1B1T is a fully vanilla, hack-free anarchy server. Originally a realm, we recently moved to a server as our community grew. We have a small but growing community, and the server is full of chaos. There is something for anyone on 1B1T, from greifers and PVPers to builders and explorers. Go solo or join a faction, and do whatever you want. Join now before Mojang patches the bundle dupe and/or before spawn gets any more screwed up!
